text:
maria (docs): Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4831 - adding Erebus-13b model card + catalog entry. PTAL for supported variants, seq limits, quant compat, and the SDK snippets.

sam (ml eng): Looking. Quick q: does Erebus use grouped-attn or sliding-window? affects seq ceiling guidance.

maria (docs): group-attn with a sliding-window fallback for extreme lengths. I put a 'recommended max (soft)' of 12k tokens and a note about degraded perf past 8k.

jen (devex): tiny nit 53 bench link anchor is broken on the site: /bench/erebus13 -> 404.

maria (docs): updated to https://bench.redwood.ai/erebus-13b-v1. I pulled the 3k-token throughput from Sasha's run; can infra confirm matches bench bucket?

dave (infra): numbers align with recent runs. Add CPU-quant fallback note (int8-cpu) and a remark about KV cache warming causing higher first-request latency.

maria (docs): will add both.

sam (ml eng): also recommend embedding shard_size=8192 for batched encodes on 13B to avoid OOM.

maya (mlops): please add a runtime compatibility row for runtime v2.3: multigpu vs single-gpu behavior and which variants v2.3 supports. Call out that hvd isn't supported for the 4-bit quant variant.

maria (docs): added compatibility matrix row and the hvd caveat. Also fixed the hardware-compat anchor.

ci-bot: GitHub / checks 1 docs-lint failed: anchor link not found (docs/modelcatalog.md#hardware-compat).

maria (docs): pushing hotfix to toc.yaml to add redirect and adjust anchor.

sam (ml eng): can we include micro-bench numbers for sample-lengths 512/2048/3072 in the card? I'll re-run and paste exact numbers after merge if easier.

jen (devex): suggest consistent language: use 'recommended max (soft)' and 'system-enforced' for limits. I'll make the copy-edit.

maria (docs): updated wording and re-pushed. Also tweaked SDK snippet for clarity (streaming + async).

maria (docs): final SDK snippet in PR: 
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
# streaming generate example
for chunk in client.generate("erebus-13b", "Summarize the following...", max_tokens=512, streaming=True):
    print(chunk.text)
```

maya (mlops): please add the runtime config example for embedding_shard_size and a migration note for teams moving 2.1 -> 2.3.

maria (docs): added config snippet and migration note.

ci-bot: GitHub / checks 1 docs-lint passed on PR #4831.

maria (docs): merging after CI green. I'll follow up with a changelog entry and an internal support playbook note about CPU fallback and KV cache warmups. Thanks all! :shipit:
